inj.note: Phillips has not practiced since aggravating a hamstring injury in the Panthers' Week 6 win over the Eagles. The linebacker is steadily recovering and enters Week 9 prep as a potential day-to-day practice participant. If Phillips can suit up this Sunday, he will be faced with the Broncos' dominant offensive line in his return.

news.h: Pass rusher Jaelan Phillips among four Panthers ruled out for TNF vs. Packers
news.d: The Panthers ruled out four players, including starting OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and left guard Damien Lewis (knee) for "Thursday Night Football."
